verdict.rationale: Ramp's machine-readable docs index publishes a canonical OpenAPI schema at /openapi/developer-api.json, plus a generated plain-text endpoint and schema reference (/llms-api.txt). An independent probe confirmed the OpenAPI file is live: it returns HTTP 200 and parses as "Ramp Developer API" v1 with 174 documented paths. The unauthenticated Developer MCP server additionally exposes the OpenAPI schemas to AI assistants, and a probe confirmed it responds without credentials.
